anti_variant_shopping: Do not change the 25% truncation fraction after any benchmark execution.
Do not switch to stale-result substitution, edge deletion, contradiction injection, or another perturbation.
Do not choose a different eligible read based on observed behavior; always use the first eligible read_file request.
Do not extend the 20-tool-call eligibility search after observing invalid pairs.
Do not expose raw perturbation bookkeeping to the scorer.
Do not change the post-fork scoring anchor or signal window after any result.
claim_boundary: A positive result supports directional mechanism sensitivity to this one upstream information-loss intervention. It does not establish contradiction detection, general perturbation detection, task correctness, or predictive validity.

fork_and_injection.clean_branch: Return the exact UTF-8 text that read_file would normally return from the cloned workspace.
fork_and_injection.common_prefix: For each pair, execute one common agent prefix from the frozen repository checkpoint and task until the first eligible read_file tool call has been requested by the agent but before its tool result is delivered. Persist and clone the complete agent/checkpointer/workspace state at that boundary into two branches.

eligibility.if_no_eligible_event: PAIR_INSTRUMENTATION_INVALID; seal this status while still blinded; do not replace the pair and do not inspect condition-linked metric effects.

fork_and_injection.one_shot: Apply the perturbation only to that single eligible tool result. Every later tool call in both branches executes normally against its own evolving workspace.
fork_and_injection.perturbed_branch: Let text contain N Unicode code points. Remove exactly ceil(N/4) code points from the end and return the remaining prefix. Do not add a truncation marker, warning, synthetic error, or condition label.

invalidity_rules_blinded: workspace cannot be cloned byte-identically at fork
no eligible read_file request occurs within first 20 common-prefix tool calls
eligible read_file result is not strict UTF-8 or has fewer than 1024 code points
instrumentation cannot emit all required frozen signal observations
branch receives a different model/tool/budget configuration
name: single_silent_read_tail_truncation_25pct
no_replacement: A mechanically invalid randomized pair is not replaced after assignment. Invalidity is sealed while condition-blind and reported in the final denominator accounting.
scientific_intent: Introduce one mechanically defined upstream information-loss perturbation before the affected continuation is instrumented, then observe whether the agent's natural operational behavior produces higher kappa. The perturbation does not directly edit kappa inputs or graph labels.

scoring_boundary.anchor: fork checkpoint immediately before the eligible read_file result is delivered
scoring_boundary.raw_payload_policy: Before scorer ingestion, remove raw tool-result text from both branches. Preserve only the structural operational events required by the frozen signal schema.
scoring_boundary.signal_window: post-fork continuation only, through frozen termination condition

forbidden: setting revision counters directly because the condition is PERTURBED
editing dependency edges solely to encode condition
editing state-change counters solely to encode condition
signal_noninterference.rule: Revision pressure, dependency churn, and state-change density must arise only from the agent's subsequent natural execution and the frozen operational-event mapper.
